quarterly_data.signal: Full-year 2025 results as filed in the 20-F: Total Revenue was $58,739 million (2024: $54,073 million), made up of Product Sales of $55,573 million, Alliance Revenue of $3,067 million and Collaboration Revenue of $99 million. Alliance Revenue included Enhertu $1,798 million, Tezspire $673 million, Beyfortus $422 million and Datroway $77 million. Research and development expense was $14,232 million, operating profit $13,743 million and profit for the period $10,233 million (diluted EPS $6.54). By country, US Total Revenue was $23,970 million, China $6,636 million and Japan $3,556 million. Capital expenditure on property, plant and equipment was $2,927 million (2024: $1,995 million), and contracts placed for future capital expenditure on property, plant and equipment and software development costs not provided for in the financial statements totalled $1,727 million.
